thought.text: The bug is on line 29: `end = start + per_page - 1` computes an inclusive end index, but Python slices are exclusive. So `raw_items[start:end]` drops the last item of every page. The fix is to make `end` exclusive:

reasoning_content: The off-by-one bug: `end = start + per_page - 1` and `start:end` slice is exclusive of end. So for page 1, per_page=2: start=0, end=1, slice [0:1] = ["a"]. Correct behavior should be ["a", "b"]. Fix: `end = start + per_page` (exclusive) or just use `raw_items[start:start + per_page]`.

action.old_str:
end = start + per_page - 1
    return Page(
        number=page,
        per_page=per_page,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        items=raw_items[start:end],
    )

    return Page(
